```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(car)
```

```{r}
hr <- read_csv("heart_rate.csv")

hr <- hr %>%
  clean_names()

str(hr)
```

```{r}
hr_data <- hr %>%
  select(
    concentration_ug_l,
    heart_rate_bpm) %>%
  filter(!is.na(heart_rate_bpm)) %>%
  mutate(concentration_ug_l = factor(concentration_ug_l))

str(hr_data)
```

heart rate linear model
```{r}
heart_model<-lm(heart_rate_bpm ~ concentration_ug_l, data = hr_data)
summary(heart_model)
```

heart rate ANOVA
```{r}
hr_anova<-aov(heart_rate_bpm ~ concentration_ug_l, data = hr_data)
summary(hr_anova)
```

```{r}
hatch <- read_csv("hatching.csv")

hatch <- hatch %>%
  clean_names()

str(hatch)
```

```{r}
hatch_data <- hatch %>%
  select(
    concentration_ug_l,
    contains("percent_hatched"),
    plate_number)
```

long form hatch data
```{r}
hatch_long <- hatch_data %>%
  select(
    concentration_ug_l,
    plate_number,
    x2_dpf_percent_hatched,
    x3dpf_percent_hatched,
    x4dpf_percent_hatched
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),
    names_to = "dpf",
    values_to = "percent_hatched"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dpf = dplyr::recode(
  dpf,
  "x2_dpf_percent_hatched" = "2",
  "x3dpf_percent_hatched" = "3",
  "x4dpf_percent_hatched" = "4"
),
    dpf = factor(dpf),
    concentration_ug_l = factor(concentration_ug_l),
    plate_number = factor(plate_number)
  )
```

hatch model
```{r}
hatch_model <- lmer(
  percent_hatched ~ concentration_ug_l * dpf +
    (1 | plate_number),
  data = hatch_long
)

summary(hatch_model)
anova(hatch_model)
```

pair-wise post hoc
```{r}
emm_hatch <- emmeans(hatch_model, ~ concentration_ug_l | dpf)

pairs(emm_hatch, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

heart_plot <- ggplot(hr_data, aes(x = concentration_ug_l, y = heart_rate_bpm)) +

  # Mean ± SE
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15,
    color = "black"
  ) +

  # Raw data
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = concentration_ug_l),
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.6,
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "0"       = "#00441B",  # darkest green
      "1e-04"   = "#238B45",
      "0.001"   = "#41AB5D",
      "0.01"    = "#74C476",
      "0.1"     = "#A1D99B"   # lightest green
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  labs(
    x = expression("PTU Concentration (g/L)"),
    y = "Heart rate (bpm)"
  ) +

  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "ICBF_figures/heart_rate.png",
  plot = heart_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
hatch_plot <- ggplot(
  hatch_long,
  aes(
    x = dpf,
    y = percent_hatched,
    colour = concentration_ug_l,
    group = concentration_ug_l
  )
) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "0"      = "#00441B",
      "1e-04"  = "#238B45",
      "0.001"  = "#41AB5D",
      "0.01"   = "#74C476",
      "0.1"    = "#A1D99B"
    ),
    name = expression("PTU (g/L)")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Days post fertilization",
    y = "Percent hatched (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "ICBF_figures/hatch.png",
  plot = hatch_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
mortality <- read_csv("mortality.csv")

mortality <- mortality %>%
  clean_names()

str(mortality)
```

```{r}
mortality_data <- mortality %>%
  select(
    concentration_ug_l,
    contains("percent_survival"),
    plate_number)

str(mortality_data)
```

long form mortality data
```{r}
mortality_long <- mortality_data %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("x"),
    names_to = "dpf",
    values_to = "percent_survival"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dpf = factor(
      gsub("_dpf_percent_survival", "", gsub("x", "", dpf)),
      levels = 2:10
    ),
    concentration_ug_l = factor(concentration_ug_l),
    plate_number = factor(plate_number)
  )
```

mortality model
```{r}
mortality_model <- lmer(
  percent_survival ~ concentration_ug_l * dpf +
    (1 | plate_number),
  data = mortality_long
)

summary(mortality_model)
anova(mortality_model)
```

pair-wise post hoc
```{r}
emm_mortality <- emmeans(mortality_model, ~ concentration_ug_l | dpf)

pairs(emm_mortality, adjust = "tukey")
```

```{r}
mortality_plot <- ggplot(
  mortality_long,
  aes(
    x = dpf,
    y = percent_survival,
    colour = concentration_ug_l,
    group = concentration_ug_l
  )
) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3
  ) +

  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.15
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "0"      = "#00441B",
      "1e-04"  = "#238B45",
      "0.001"  = "#41AB5D",
      "0.01"   = "#74C476",
      "0.1"    = "#A1D99B"
    ),
    name = expression("PTU (g/L)")
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Days post fertilization",
    y = "Percent survival (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "ICBF_figures/mortality.png",
  plot = mortality_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
